newsitem.title: NORWAY: Two dead in Norway avalanche, skiers missing.
newsitem.headline: Two dead in Norway avalanche, skiers missing.

text.p: Two mountain climbers were killed by an avalanche in north Norway and about 20 skiers were missing in snowy weather around the country, the national news agency NTB said on Friday.

The climbers, both men in their 30s, were reported missing on Thursday after they failed to return from a mountain trek in Helgeland. A Red Cross team with dogs on Friday found them buried in an avalanche, NTB quoted police as saying.
They were the first victims of snowy weather during the Easter holiday in the Scandinavian country.
Norwegians traditionally spend Easter skiing in the mountains but this year many have been caught in snow storms which have forced many roads to be closed down.
On Friday rescuers searched for about 20 people reported missing while on ski treks in various parts of the country, NTB said.

Searches launched at the weekend have so far rescued dozens of missing people, some of whom survived nights in the open by digging caves in the snow and using mobile telephones to report their location to police, news reports said.
